katastrophe.erholt_text: The situation in {ort} has calmed; the region is back on its feet.
katastrophe.frist_chronik_text: {ort}: After {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} the acute emergency has subsided.
katastrophe.frist_text: After {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} the event no longer shapes everyday life in the region; what remains are the consequences for the country and its economy.
katastrophe.frist_text_zusage: After {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} the acute emergency is considered over. The public promise stands: {geliefert, number} of {bedarf, number} homes have been delivered, and the rest will continue to be measured.
katastrophe.frist_titel: {art} in {ort}: The acute emergency has subsided.
katastrophe.kette_bewaeltigt: Counts as overcome once 95 percent of the need has been delivered: so far {geliefert, number} of {bedarf, number} homes. At the latest after {frist, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} the acute emergency fades.
katastrophe.kette_duerre: Counts as overcome once the situation has calmed: after {min, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} at the earliest, when the water shortage in the basin is back at its resting level; after {frist, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} at the latest.
katastrophe.kette_ohne_bedarf: Counts as overcome once the situation has calmed, after {frist, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} at the latest.
katastrophe.zusage_unmoeglich: No housing programme of its own is an option for this damage; a public promise could not be kept.
